d: New reports in the US media say that Iran is planning to attack Washington, DC with a dirty bomb or chemical weapons. The reports come just as the US sends a third aircraft carrier to the West Asia/Middle East region. Iran says that American media is trying to manufacture consent for the war to resume. Meanwhile, Donald Trump is heading to Asia amid mounting political troubles at home, hoping to restore his presidential authority and project American power on the global stage. From the US-ASEAN summit in Manila to the APEC gathering in China's Shenzhen, Trump's packed diplomatic schedule…
